blocks.text: Reversible process woh hai jise bilkul ulti tarteeb mein wapas chalaya ja sake aur mahol (surroundings) mein koi tabdeeli na aaye. Ulte process mein working substance unhi marhalon (stages) se guzarta hai jin se seedhe process mein guzra tha, magar har marhale par heat aur work ke asar bilkul ulte hote hain. Seedhe process mein heat jazb hui thi to ulte mein utni hi heat nikalti hai; seedhe process mein substance ne work kiya tha to ulte mein substance par work hota hai. Is tarah working substance apni asal halat mein wapas aa jata hai.

blocks.title: Cycle
blocks.text: Waqiaat ka aisa silsila jo system ko us ki shuru wali halat mein wapas le aaye, cycle kehlata hai. Reversible cycle woh hai jis ki saari tabdeeliyan reversible hon.

Asal zindagi mein koi tabdeeli poori tarah reversible nahi hoti, magar kisi cheez ka liquification (gas se liquid banna) aur evaporation (liquid se gas banna) agar aahista kiye jayein to taqreeban reversible hain. Isi tarah cylinder mein gas ko aahista dabana reversible hai, kyun ke piston par pressure aahista kam kar ke compression ko expansion mein badla ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Irreversible process
blocks.text: Jo process control karne wali cheezon (jaise pressure ya temperature) ko ulta karne se bhi peeche ki taraf wapas na chalaya ja sake, woh irreversible process hai.

Jo tabdeeliyan achanak hon, ya jin mein friction (ragar) ho, ya conduction, convection ya radiation se energy bikhar (dissipate) jaye, woh sab irreversible hain. Bohat zyada irreversible process ki misal explosion (dhamaka) hai.

blocks.prompt: Reversible aur irreversible process mein farq batayein. Bina friction wale cylinder mein gas ka aahista compression reversible kyun hai, aur friction reversibility kyun khatam karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Reversible process unhi halaton se ulta chalaya ja sakta hai, har heat aur work ka len den ulta ho jata hai, aur mahol par koi nishan nahi rehta; irreversible aisa nahi kar sakta (har achanak tabdeeli aur friction wala process). Aahista, bina friction compression mein piston ka pressure aahista kam karne se gas wapas phail jati hai, is liye yeh taqreeban reversible hai. Friction work ko aisi heat mein badal deti hai jo wapas wahi work nahi ban sakti, is liye mahol badal jata hai.

items: Reversible: bilkul ulta chal sake aur mahol na badle (aahista liquification, evaporation, aahista compression). Cycle system ko shuru wali halat mein wapas lata hai; reversible cycle mein saari tabdeeliyan reversible.
Irreversible: achanak tabdeeliyan, friction, conduction/convection/radiation se energy ka bikharna; misal: explosion.
